name: Stack-Based Representation (SBR)
definition: Decomposition of a voxel grid V (resolution w × h × d) into a set S of vertical stacks, where each stack Sx,y represents the column of voxels at position xy.
summary: Stack-Based Representation is a sparse volume data structure that compresses vertical columns via run-length encoding, exploiting vertical coherence to efficiently store layered datasets unlike isotropic sparse grids.
